units.title: Unit 1 — Greetings, Pronouns & Basics
units.description: First exchanges to introduce yourself and ask simple questions.

units.title: Unit 2 — Family, People & Food
units.description: Talking about family, people around you, and everyday food.

units.title: Unit 3 — Numbers, Dates & Time
units.description: Counting, telling the time, dates, and age.

units.title: Unit 4 — Places, Directions & Home
units.description: Getting around and describing everyday spaces.

units.title: Unit 5 — Actions, Shopping & Weather
units.description: Expressing daily actions, shopping, and talking about the weather.

units.title: Unit 6 — Qualities, Modals & Connectors
units.description: Describing things, using modal verbs, and linking ideas.
